title: Appendix Planck spectral energy plot u(λ, T2) vs. wavelength
description: Mathcad-style graph with green gridlines plotting u(λ, T2) on the vertical axis (0 to 600) against wavelength λ (0 to 1×10^-5 m). Only a short red rising segment of the curve appears between about 1×10^-6 and 2×10^-6. No figure caption is given on the page.
